name: external-agents
description: Hands tasks and reviews to other vendors' official coding-agent CLIs (Codex first) through their documented headless surfaces: one skill per CLI, one shared runner with per-use sandbox ceilings, job files and a breaker, and the external-agents command that review:council calls.

antigravity_uses_task_mode.title: Antigravity task mode
antigravity_uses_task_mode.description: Default and ceiling for agy task runs on this machine, in every repository. read-only (default) keeps them read-only; write lets a --mode write run edit files. agy write mode has no network isolation. A repository's team or personal external-agents.yaml overrides it.

antigravity_uses_investigate_mode.title: Antigravity investigate mode
antigravity_uses_investigate_mode.description: Default and ceiling for agy investigate runs on this machine, in every repository. read-only (default) or write; agy write mode has no network isolation. A repository's team or personal external-agents.yaml overrides it.

codex_uses_task_mode.title: Codex task mode
codex_uses_task_mode.description: Default and ceiling for Codex task runs on this machine, in every repository. write (default) or read-only. A repository's team or personal external-agents.yaml overrides it.

codex_uses_investigate_mode.title: Codex investigate mode
codex_uses_investigate_mode.description: Default and ceiling for Codex investigate runs on this machine, in every repository. read-only (default) or write. A repository's team or personal external-agents.yaml overrides it.
